summary: Frontend-only verification of shared ModulePageHeader applied across all 5 modules (Operations, Memberships, CRM, Marketing, Comms Centre) for owner@isodemo.com on viewport 1920x800. All headers render the unified pattern (gradient module name + muted '· Iso Demo Fitness' + one-line subtitle + right-aligned long-form date) and the ModuleSwitcher pill bar + tab pills render directly beneath without overlap. Studio Mode toggle confirmed in Memberships action slot. None of the legacy product-brand titles ('Pulse Fitness Pro', 'Pulse Fitness', 'Dashboard') are present.

critical_code_review_comments: Date is computed client-side via new Date(); deterministic SSR/testing would prefer the date prop to be passed in by container. Currently fine because every container omits it.
ModulePageHeader is small (78 lines) and focused — good DRY refactor; consider memoizing with React.memo since it runs on every parent re-render across busy modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shared ModulePageHeader is verified across all 5 modules. Switching modules via module-switcher pill bar works and re-renders header correctly. No regressions in tab pills below. Cookie banner appears bottom-center but does not occlude header area.
